description: This file defines an 'Product' class in the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It handles adding, editing, and deleting product events by scheduling corresponding tasks.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Controller class that manages event hooks for product-related actions such as add, edit, and delete in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate product info after a product is added.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Schedules a task to update product info after a product is edited.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle product deletion after a product is deleted.
